description: Starts an After Hours AI receptionist for the signed-in owner's business, prepaid and billed per answered call (calls10: 10 calls for $15; calls50: 50 calls for $75). A call is charged only when your line answers a real phone call and it lasts 20 seconds or more. Not charged: calls under that, robocalls the line recognises, calls from your own numbers or from ours, website and widget chats, text messages, and any call whose transcript cannot be read. Nothing is built or bought until the owner pays: this returns a Stripe checkout link for the first pack, and the line (agent and phone number) is set up automatically once that is paid; its number and forwarding codes are then emailed to the account's address. Only call it after showing the owner https://odilelabs.com/terms and getting a yes. United States only (the business line and the owner's mobile must be US numbers). Needs a signed-in connection with the lines:manage permission; limited to 3 set-ups a day per account. Returns { setup_id, status: 'awaiting payment', business_name, business_phone, pack, calls, price_cents, checkout_url, then }.

business_name.description: The business name callers should hear, e.g. "Alvarez Plumbing".

business_phone.description: The business number callers dial today (US, with area code). The owner forwards it to the new line.

description.description: What the business does, in one line; this is what it tells callers.

extra.description: Anything else the receptionist should know.

hours.description: Opening hours by day name, e.g. {"Monday": {"open": "8:00 AM", "close": "5:00 PM"}, "Sunday": "closed"}. A day left out is closed. Omit entirely for Monday to Friday, 9 to 5.

languages.description: Languages besides English the receptionist switches to when a caller does.

owner_confirmed_terms.description: true ONLY after you showed the owner https://odilelabs.com/terms and they said yes. Anything else is refused.

owner_mobile.description: The owner's own mobile (US, with area code): their calls to the line are never charged.

pack.description: The first pack: calls10: 10 calls for $15; calls50: 50 calls for $75.

services.description: Up to 12 services, e.g. ["drain cleaning", "water heaters"].

name: set_up_answering_line
title: Set up an After Hours answering line (billed per answered call)
